demo.cliff: a whole subsystem behind a world setting
teaches: `subType: "psionic"` is the second talent sub-type, and it is where the `psionic` block stops being dead weight.
`psionic.cost` is the strength spent on each use; `reach` is the band it carries to; `duration` and `durationUnit` are stored apart so the sheet can print either half.
`roll.characteristic: "psionic"` is what puts the check on the psionic characteristic instead of a skill's usual one.
demo.trap: Psionics is an optional rule and it is off by default. Until the referee turns it on in the world settings, this Item is carried, listed and never rolled — and `characteristics.psionic` is not shown on any sheet.

system.description: Pushing a sentence into a mind that is not listening. Invented for this pack, and not any book's talent.
